choices.text: The people is worried about rents.
People is worried about the rents.
The people are worry about rents.

questions.explanation_md: *People* es plural (*are*) y en sentido general no lleva *the*; *worried* es adjetivo.

questions.prompt_md: Which option is the best **paraphrase** of *The council has not made a decision yet*?

choices.text: The council has not made a decision yet.

questions.explanation_md: (c) mantiene el significado con otras palabras. (a) copia; (b) y (d) cambian el sentido.

questions.prompt_md: How many words are there in this sentence? *The council doesn't know what to do.*
questions.explanation_md: The / council / doesn't / know / what / to / do = 7. Las contracciones cuentan como una palabra.

questions.prompt_md: Question: *Why do supporters like these parks?* Which opening sentence is best for a 40–60 word answer?

choices.text: In my country we also have many parks and I like them.
Supporters like these parks because they improve people's well-being and bring neighbours together.
Rotterdam is a city in the Netherlands.

questions.explanation_md: Responde directamente reutilizando las palabras clave de la pregunta (Point). Las demás no responden o se desvían.
